title: Owner check: one automatic update
goal: The owner sees a notice, lets it apply and reads the report
acceptance: Enable the automatic policy with the command or dashboard switch added in F-102-T02 (its exact command is written into this step when T02 lands), then wait for the scheduled check; expected: a Telegram notice with the revision and time, then the update report with the after-start health check
privacy: Local only; tests use invented bases, revisions and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h, small fixes 0.5 h). Not a measurement.
